$Comment: The Headless Horseman's graveyard, the dungeon the Gravekeeper near Old Jack opens while Hallow's
Eve runs. Every area of a copy pastes Hallows_Eve/Hallows_Eve_Graveyard.prefab.json (an enclosed
night graveyard with his fight's entity, his spawn marker and a way-out pad in its entrance
room; tools/arena_markers.py writes it), so every fresh paste stages a fresh fight. The prefab's
anchor is the entrance room's floor, so EntryOffset lands an arriving party one block up, standing
on it; the Leave_Instance pad behind them takes a player back out.
Season keeps it closed outside Hallow's Eve. Share: one party to an area, up to five players, and
four areas to a copy. Complete names his fight, so the run clears when he falls, and Rewards rolls
Hallows_Eve_Graveyard_Clear for each member present as a Claim: full the first clear each day,
half on later ones. Text names it in the reader's language (hallowseve.world.lang), and its GoalKey
is the line each player reads as they arrive: what to do there, and how his fight is won.
EntryCost is the price of going in: one Grave Candle (Old Jack sells them at his stall), taken from
whoever opens an area for their party; partymates who follow into that fight walk in free. Confirm
is left out, so it is on: before anything is spent, the player opening the area sees CommonLib's
confirm screen, built like the game's portal summon screen, with the graveyard's name and
description, the candle, how many they hold and how many it takes, and a button whose words are
ConfirmKey's ("Light the Candle"); it burns the candle, sends the party in and plays the game's
portal sound and sparkle, and closing the screen spends nothing. With none, the button is off and
the HintKey line says where to buy them. Change Count to change the price, and the Gravekeeper's
way-in label, which shows it, with it.
Keys lists items that open the gate without being spent: a player carrying an Eternal Candle
(Hallows_Eve_Eternal_Candle, a rare roll in the Horseman's Hoard) anywhere in the bag, storage or
hotbar opens an area for their party, keeps it, and burns no Grave Candle even holding some. The
confirm screen then shows the Eternal Candle and says it is not used up. Only this graveyard names
it; the hard graveyard has no Keys, so the hard ride always takes its candle. Add an item id to
Keys to let it open the gate too, or empty the list to make everyone pay.
